edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $[to be agreed before signing], payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices. The Executive shall be eligible for an annual bonus under any applicable Company bonus plan, with the amount and payment subject to the plan's terms and the achievement of applicable performance goals. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Company's employee benefit plans, subject to their terms.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive's employment without Cause, or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall pay the Executive an amount equal to twelve months of the Executive's then-current base salary, in installments under its regular payroll practices, and continue the Executive's health benefits for twelve months, subject to applicable law and plan terms. Severance is conditioned on the Executive's timely execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims. “Cause” means the Executive's material misconduct, material breach of this Agreement, conviction of a felony, or material failure to perform assigned duties after written notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure, if curable. “Good Reason” means a material reduction in base salary, a material diminution in duties or authority, or a required relocation of the Executive's principal workplace by more than 50 miles, in each case without the Executive's consent; the Executive must give written notice within 30 days after the condition arises, allow the Company 30 days to cure, and resign within 30 days after that cure period if the condition remains uncured.
edits.name: Severance
